## PAGING_INPUT_NAMES variable

The input names every list operation reserves for paging. No app parameter of a list operation may use either name, so a list that does not page yet can start paging without renaming one.

**Signature:**

```typescript
PAGING_INPUT_NAMES: readonly[('pageSize', 'cursor')]
```
